headline: CSB Bank Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - CSB Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about approval granted by Reserve Bank of India to ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited to acquire  aggregate holding  of up to 9.95% of the paid-up share capital or…
detail: General Updates - CSB Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about approval granted by Reserve Bank of India to ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited to acquire  aggregate holding  of up to 9.95% of the paid-up share capital or voting rights in CSB Bank Limited
